$comment: The rewards layer (docs/design/first-voyage.md section 4): every deed the captain does is said by a deed card and kept on the log's Deeds page. Each of the career's first 'goals.paid' goals done pays 'goals.gold' into the purse (a governor's or merchant's thanks; later goals pay only in what they bring). A sale whose profit is 'bigTrade' or more is a deed of its own.

flotsam.$comment: Small surprises at sea: each day under way out of port (not on the First Voyage's guided steps) there is 'chancePerDay' of a find: a sea chest adrift ('gold' between the two, into the plunder chest) or, 'casksShare' of the time, casks of one of 'goods' ('casks' between the two, as her hold has room).
